title: Concertino project config
description: Per-project configuration that parameterizes the Concertino agent orchestra. `concertino sync` renders the harness-specific files from core/ + this config.

harnesses.description: Which harness adapters to render on sync. Also drives the static CONCERTINO_HARNESS default written to .concertino.env: the single value when exactly one harness is configured, else empty (setup-worktree.sh resolves the actual value at runtime).

name.description: Human label used in agent prose.

baseBranch.description: Branch PRs target and diffs compare against.

baseRemote.description: Remote PRs target and diffs/fast-forward compare against.

idExample.description: Sample ticket id, e.g. HEL-26, used in rendered examples.

teamKey.description: Linear team key the launch pad fetches tickets for, e.g. CON. Distinct from idExample, which is only a sample id for agent prose and is often a placeholder. Falls back to the idExample prefix when unset; LINEAR_TEAM_KEY overrides both.

changeDir.description: Change directory template; <CHANGE_NAME> is filled at runtime.

scaffoldCmd.description: Command to scaffold a new change (<CHANGE_NAME> substituted at runtime).

envFiles.description: Uncommitted files copied into each worktree (e.g. backend/.env).

linkModules.description: Module directories (relative to repo root, e.g. frontend/node_modules) to populate in each worktree so pre-commit hooks that need installed deps can run without `git commit -n`. Rendered as CONCERTINO_LINK_MODULES. Each dir is hardlink-copied (cp -al) from the main checkout when the lockfile at dirname(dir)/package-lock.json matches, else `npm ci` is run in dirname(dir). The lockfile is assumed at dirname(dir)/package-lock.json.

hooks.description: Commands run inside the worktree after creation (e.g. npx husky install).

devServers.description: Backend/frontend dev-server commands. Omit a side that doesn't exist.

gates.description: Verification gates. Each runs only when changed files match `when`.

when.description: Glob matched against changed files, or 'always'.

canonicalDocs.description: Project standards agents are bound to read just-in-time.

when.description: 'always' or a glob; binding only applies when changed files match.

dashboard.description: Settings for `concertino watch`, the fleet dashboard. Distinct from `ui`, which describes whether the project under test has a user interface.

tmuxSession.description: tmux session name holding one window per run.

launchCommand.description: Command `n` runs in a new tmux window. `{{TICKET}}` is substituted with the ticket id. Defaults from the configured harness: `claude "/concertino-deliver {{TICKET}}"` when claude-code is configured, else the first configured harness's CLI (`codex "..."`, or `opencode --prompt "..."`). Setting it pins the command for every ticket — per-ticket `harness:<value>` label dispatch only applies when this is unset.

maxConcurrent.description: Cap on simultaneously running orchestrators launched from the launch pad's queue runner (lib/ui/queue.js). Sequential batches use maxConcurrent 1 — the same code path, not a separate one. Editable per-batch on the launch plan screen ('c'); this is only the default.

escalationTimeoutMinutes.description: How long `emit-event.sh --await` blocks before giving up and letting the agent fall back to presenting the escalation in chat. Rendered into CONCERTINO_ESCALATION_TIMEOUT_MIN in .concertino.env by `concertino sync`. The orchestrator invokes --await inside a single harness command call, which has its own outer timeout (Claude Code caps a Bash call at ~10 minutes) — keep this comfortably under that, or the harness kills the wait before --await's own timeout can fire and log escalation.timeout cleanly.

reapDeliveredAfterMinutes.description: Minutes to leave a DELIVERED run's tmux window open after it finishes, before the dashboard closes it. A harness returns to its prompt rather than exiting when the workflow ends, so without this an idle session holds a process, a window, and (with Remote Control enabled for all sessions) a phone-visible registration indefinitely. Scrollback is captured before the window is closed. A run still waiting on an escalation is never closed regardless. Set 0 to disable and only ever close windows that are already dead.

retentionDays.description: How long, in days, a terminal run's event log under `.concertino/runs/<TICKET>/` is kept before `concertino prune` (or the best-effort prune at `concertino watch` startup) removes it. A run that has not yet emitted a `run.end` event is never pruned, regardless of age.

enabled.description: Enables the ticket-provider launch pad, reached from `concertino watch`'s fleet view on 'N'. Read by lib/ui/linear.js launchPadStatus(), which additionally requires ticketProvider.kind=linear and a non-empty LINEAR_API_KEY — 'N' is always bound and explains whichever of the three is missing rather than doing nothing.

backlog.description: Whether the launch pad's fetch includes backlog-state tickets. Default true preserves today's behaviour (backlog, unstarted and started tickets all fetched). Set to exactly false to exclude backlog tickets — read by lib/ui/linear.js stateTypesFromConfig(), for a project whose backlog dwarfs its active work (see docs/dashboard.md).

models.description: Explicit per-harness, per-role model overrides (design.md Decision 1 of delivery-speed-presets). Sparse by design — a role absent here falls back to the active speed's roleTiers entry resolved through modelTiers.<harness>. Only roles a project has deliberately pinned should appear; withDefaults() never invents an entry here (unlike modelTiers, which IS defaulted), since presence here means 'explicit override, ignore the speed'.

modelTiers.description: Per-harness tier -> concrete model. A speed's roleTiers names a tier (cheap/standard/capable); this is what resolves that tier to an actual model string for the harness in play. withDefaults() fills in every harness's tiers when a project doesn't set them, so an unconfigured project resolves identically to today's sonnet-everywhere/codex-mini-latest-everywhere behavior at the standard tier.

providers.description: Provider-aware model configuration, distinct from harnesses (the three tools that render). Scoped today to a single named provider, ollama. A project with no providers key behaves identically to a project that never configured it.

ollama.description: Points a subset of this project's configured harnesses at a locally-hosted Ollama instance.

baseUrl.description: Ollama's own API endpoint (not the OpenAI-compatible /v1 suffix — each harness's adapter appends what it needs).

apiKeyEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding a credential for baseUrl, if Ollama is behind auth — never the credential value itself.

harnesses.description: Subset of this project's configured harnesses that should route through Ollama. Not inferred from model-id strings — provider and harness are independent dimensions.

models.description: Per-role fallback model id, used when a harness is Ollama-routed and models.<harness>.<role> has no explicit override.

gateway.description: Anthropic-compatible proxy (e.g. LiteLLM) Claude Code requires to reach Ollama. Required when claude-code appears in providers.ollama.harnesses.

apiKeyEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the gateway credential — never the credential value itself.

speeds.description: Named presets (fast/default/slow) resolving a run's budgets override + per-role model tier + (slow-only) two behavioral flags. Resolved per-run by scripts/concertino/resolve-speed.sh from a sync-time snapshot (scripts/concertino/speeds.json) of this block + modelTiers + models. withDefaults() synthesizes an implicit `default` speed (empty budgets override, every role at the `standard` tier) when this key is absent entirely, so an unmigrated project's runs are untouched.

agentMerge.description: Whether a verified run may merge its own PR via the cold auditor role, instead of stopping for a human 'merged' confirmation. Per-run override (--agent-merge/--no-agent-merge, the n prompt, the launch plan) takes precedence over this default.

enabled.description: Project-level default. false preserves today's human-confirms-merge flow for every run that doesn't explicitly override it.

mergeMethod.description: Passed to `gh pr merge --<mergeMethod>` when the auditor merges.

roleModelMap.description: Sparse per-role explicit model override for one harness. Any subset of the five roles; an absent role falls back to the active speed's tier resolution.

tierMap.description: The three named tiers a speed's roleTiers picks from, resolved to one concrete model string per tier for this harness.

speed.description: One named speed preset: a partial budgets override merged over the top-level budgets block, a role->tier map, and (meaningful only for slow) two behavioral flags. The schema permits the two flags on any speed for forward-compatibility, but the shipped default config never sets them true outside slow — the final skeptic gate itself is never gated by any of these fields (see delivery-speed-presets spec: 'The final skeptic gate runs at every speed').

budgets.description: Partial override merged over the project's top-level budgets — any field omitted here falls back to the top-level default, never to a hardcoded number.

roleTiers.description: Role -> cheap|standard|capable. Resolved per harness through modelTiers.<harness>.<tier>, unless models.<harness>.<role> is set explicitly (which always wins).

secondFinalGateSkeptic.description: slow-only: spawn a second, independent cold skeptic at the final gate; a disagreement between the two verdicts is a BLOCKER to the human, never resolved automatically. Never removes the baseline final gate any speed already requires — this can only ADD a second one.

evaluatorCleanWorktree.description: slow-only: the evaluator re-runs gates from a clean checkout rather than trusting the executor's own worktree state.
